layout: Main hub after login. Top nav with greeting. Scrollable content sections. Bottom tab bar (Home active). Desktop: 3-column layout. Mobile: single column.
elements: TOP NAV: Navy (#0B1B3B) bar. Left: greeting 'Hello, [Name]!' + small avatar. Right: notification bell with badge count
SUMMARY STATS: 4 cards in a row (2x2 grid on mobile). Each card: white bg, 16px radius, icon + number + label
Ring/circle chart showing percentage to goal (e.g. 60% toward Bulk target)
Inside ring: '60%' large text, '8 of 12 sessions' small text below
Below ring: goal name, target date, remaining sessions needed
UPCOMING SESSIONS: Horizontal scrollable row. 3 mini cards.
Each card: Buddy photo (small), name, date, time, duration. Orange border for next session
WORKOUT HISTORY: Vertical list. Each item: buddy photo, name, date, duration, rating stars you gave, 'Re-book' ghost button
YOUR BUDDIES: Horizontal scrollable row of saved/favorite buddies. Circular avatar + name
REFERRAL BANNER: Orange-tinted card. 'Invite a friend, get 30% off!' + 'Share' button
BOTTOM TAB BAR: Floating pill. Home (active orange), Explore, Bookings, Favorites, Profile
notes: Most important for retention. Progress ring is motivating. Upcoming sessions are prominent. Empty state for new users: friendly 'Book your first session!' CTA.
